cards.title: Who can do this
items: Open Integrations and request an integration: any signed-in role
Connect, choose, reconnect, disconnect: 'connectors' role (admin and above)
Members see a read-only note and request buttons only

cards.title: Refusals and limits
items: OAuth start refusals show a raw JSON page (401, 403, 404, 503, 400)
Publish buttons show on Rejected cards too; the server refuses them
Publish also refuses brand violations and wrong targets
A 70 s publock: a publish while it is held gets 409 publish_busy
Timeouts, network errors and 5xx count as 'may have posted'; marker kept 3 days
Text with {{1}} slots or [VO] directions is not published as written
A refused OAuth token flags the connection: Reconnect on Integrations

cards.title: While the model is paused
items: Publishing makes no model call and spends no credits
So Publish to <platform> still works while model calls are paused
